goal_context: Continue toward a complete Bominal-grade Oyatie mockup; this slice upgrades the Workflow Studio surface, not the entire remaining dashboard.
change_summary: Added Bominal-style process chrome with process id, owner, SLA, validate/simulate/diff/publish commands, and local status.
Added layout, overlay, and filter toolbars matching the dense workflow-editor control model.
Added canvas simulation metrics overlay, connector grid, richer inspector tabs, editable property form, approval rule stack, and local interaction handlers.
Preserved cohesive product behavior: workflow routes remain inside the Oyatie dashboard and built-in Messenger/Mail/Community outputs remain local-only.

differences: Oyatie remains embedded inside the full application shell with the global rail, so it intentionally does not become a standalone full-window clone.
The current canvas uses Oyatie workflow objects and local-only semantics rather than copying Bominal labels and data as-is.
Remaining full-dashboard parity still needs continued pass-by-pass polish outside Workflow Studio.
suggestions: Continue the same IDE-density treatment for any remaining sparse route surfaces.
If the user asks for standalone workflow mode, add a route/state that hides the global dashboard rail and gives Workflow Studio the entire viewport.
visual_verdict.reasoning: The Workflow Studio now matches the Bominal reference in chrome density, toolbar affordances, connector palette, metrics overlay, inspector editing, and visual local interactivity while staying a cohesive Oyatie product surface.
